div.head: I Cn 19
div.ab: Gehwylc Cristen man dó, swa him ðearf is: gyme his Cristendom georne ⁊ gearwie hine eac to huselgange huru ðriwa on geare gehwá hine sylfne [s]e ðe his agene ðearfe wille understandan, swa swa heom ðearf is.

Every Christian man shall do as is his duty: he shall pay zealous regard to his Christian profession and shall likewise prepare himself for the sacrament at least three times a year, if he seeks to understand, as he ought, what is for his own good.

Ac gehwylc Cristen man do, swa him þearf is: gime his Cristendomes georne ⁊ gearwige hine eac to huselgange huru þriwa [on geare gehwa hine sylfne], þe his agene þearfe wylle understandan, swa swa him þearf sig.
